identity.name: Tangente 38
identity.one_liner: The German Bauhaus dress watch that has defined Nomos Glashütte since 1992 — a hand-wound manufacture movement in a pared-down steel case.

narrative.story: The Tangente has been Nomos's most-cited model since the brand's 1990 founding in Glashütte, Saxony. The Alpha caliber is Nomos's first in-house movement, a hand-wound movement with a 43-hour reserve and a Glashütte three-quarter plate. The 37.5mm stainless steel case, the thin bezel, and the printed Arabic numerals are the Tangente's unchanged design language since 1992. The Tangente 38 is the most-cited affordable German manufacture watch and the reference a collector cites when arguing that Glashütte watchmaking is not limited to the higher-priced A. Lange & Söhne.
narrative.collector_notes: The Alpha caliber was Nomos's first in-house movement (launched 2005). Earlier Tangente models used a Peseux 7001 base. The "38" in the name refers to the 37.5mm case diameter.
